result.topic_en: A list of talks given in a (Göttingen mathematical-physical) seminar or society, including one by Krüger, a discussion of physical questions raised by observations of the total solar eclipse of 28 July, a talk by Riemann, and a talk by Ritter on longitudinal and torsional vibrations of a stretched string.
